displayName: IoMT Compliance（智能医疗器械IoMT合规）
description: Compliance guide for connected medical devices that combine sensors, a companion app and a cloud service: it lays out the SaMD and SiMD registration paths, cybersecurity expectations, UDI traceability and remote patient monitoring scope across NMPA, FDA and EU MDR. Produces a submission-document checklist and the key points reviewers will look for. Use when a hardware product gains software, connectivity or an AI feature and the regulatory picture suddenly gets complicated. 带传感器/APP/云的智能医疗器械（IoMT）合规助手：SaMD+SiMD注册路径、网络安全IEC 81001-5-1、UDI追溯、RPM远程监测。3分钟理清联网器械的NMPA/FDA/MDR合规拼图，输出可提交文档清单与要点。
